name: EGM v0.1.0
body:
Elephant-Goldfish Model (EGM) helps you turn an idea into a specification, then test the design with fresh-context reviewers before implementation.
The drafting agent holds the project context. Reviewers examine the document and its references without the earlier conversation. You resolve trade-offs and approve the design.

**This is EGM's first tagged release.** Exact release-ZIP host validation remains pending. This release is not ready for stable-release claims.

## What's included

- **Explore and specify:** challenge an idea with `egm-brainstorm`, then build a specification section by section with `egm-draft`.
- **Review and resolve:** run fresh-context reviewers with `egm-review` or `egm-review-loop`, then work through findings with `egm-resolve`.
- **Document and maintain:** create codebase documentation with `egm-bootstrap` and compare specifications with implementation through `egm-drift-report`.
- **Complete runtime packages:** Claude and OpenAI ZIPs include the seven skills, reviewer personas, document standards, and integration guides.

This version also includes [owner-led architecture decisions](https://github.com/google/elephant-goldfish-model/pull/157) and [Claude agent-warning guidance](https://github.com/google/elephant-goldfish-model/pull/127).

## Get started

Choose your host in the [installation guide](https://github.com/google/elephant-goldfish-model/blob/v0.1.0/docs/harnesses.md#install). Install the complete plugin so skills can read their personas and standards.
For example, the documented Claude Code repository installation is:

```sh
claude plugin marketplace add google/elephant-goldfish-model
claude plugin install egm@egm
```

Start a new session, then try:

```text
/egm:egm-brainstorm Add webhook delivery to this project.
/egm:egm-draft
/egm:egm-review <path-to-your-design-draft>
```

Use `/egm-…` commands in Antigravity or select the corresponding skill in Codex.
See the [workflow guide](https://github.com/google/elephant-goldfish-model/blob/v0.1.0/docs/getting_started.md) for details.
Repository installation follows the marketplace. To validate this release candidate, install the exact attached ZIP and record its installed identity.

## Compatibility and known limits

The [test record](https://github.com/google/elephant-goldfish-model/blob/v0.1.0/TESTING.md#harness-test-record) documents these **earlier candidate tests**, dated October 22, 2026:

| Host | Recorded evidence |
| --- | --- |
| Antigravity CLI `1.4.5` | Installation, workflow fixtures, and isolation passed. Interactive approvals, bootstrap, and synthesizer nesting remain untested. The bootstrap skill is larger than the load limit. |
| Claude Code `2.1.308` | Local plugin load, workflow fixtures, and isolation passed after a stage-order fix. The report retains shutdown and fixture limits. |
| Codex CLI `0.163.0` | Installation, workflow fixtures, isolation, required reads, and stage order passed in two live tests. |
| Claude Cowork cloud | Partial workflow verification; reviewer isolation remains unverified. See [#105](https://github.com/google/elephant-goldfish-model/issues/105). |
| ChatGPT Work | Partial native-trace and artifact verification; see [#106](https://github.com/google/elephant-goldfish-model/issues/106). |

**These results do not establish passes for the attached ZIPs.** Exact-artifact installation, workflow, and isolation checks remain open in [#60](https://github.com/google/elephant-goldfish-model/issues/60).

Claude Code isolation requires version `2.1.271` or later. The OpenAI archive declares local execution; earlier cloud tests do not establish cloud support for it.
Goldfish reviews require native fresh-context subagents. Stop the review if the host cannot provide them.
There is no earlier tagged release to migrate from. Public directory approval remains separate.

## Downloads and verification

Use the runtime ZIP for your host from the release assets. GitHub's automatic source archives are repository snapshots.

| Runtime asset | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- |
| `egm-claude-0.1.0.zip` | `11dece3e1ac5c20161a54a19e1cc77e5798af04e6a7abe42909b8636c5816511` |
| `egm-openai-0.1.0.zip` | `5f17b3942eaccc657621dfa550ef9fcaf626ad7d170085a9ef98a0e9e8afcefb` |

Both downloads match the official workflow artifacts byte for byte. ZIP integrity, tagged-source file contents, checksums, and signed provenance verification passed.
Verify your downloads with:

```sh
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS
for archive in egm-claude-*.zip egm-openai-*.zip; do
  gh attestation verify "$archive" --repo google/elephant-goldfish-model \
    --signer-workflow google/elephant-goldfish-model/.github/workflows/release.yml \
    --source-ref refs/heads/main || exit 1
done
```

<details>
<summary>Build identity and offline test evidence</summary>

- Annotated tag: `v0.1.0`.
- Tagged source: `b3a35956759bf7f024af2ff061b2e0b44b438e4c`.
- All three versioned manifests: `0.1.0`.
- [Release run 40468086866](https://github.com/google/elephant-goldfish-model/actions/runs/40468086866): succeeded from `main`; checked tag ancestry; passed 135 offline tests on Ubuntu 24.04.
- [Main CI run 40444991426](https://github.com/google/elephant-goldfish-model/actions/runs/40444991426): passed 135 offline tests on both Ubuntu 24.04 and Windows 2025.
- Verified ZIP provenance identifies the official `release.yml` workflow, `refs/heads/main`, source SHA above, and release run `40468086866`.
- The annotated tag is unsigned. GitHub Actions signed the ZIP provenance.
- No live host tests ran against these exact ZIPs during release preparation. Offline tests and provenance do not establish host support.

</details>
